verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent platform, so self-validation through generated and executed tests is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents automatic test generation, test execution, or a validate-before-propose workflow. The related features it does document (skills, MCP tools, approval gates, live correction) are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
